description: The world's clock, after the Python timeSystem and sky (docs/engine-reference/base-game-script.py): a game minute every five seconds of play (its 0.2 speed multiplier and 60-second step), starting at 23:00 on 1.1.0001, with the Gregorian months and leap years. The day's phases follow its morning, day, evening and midnight ranges; `dark` is how much of a map's night is laid (maps with the `day_night` switch), and `sky` and `sun` are its colours (DAY, EVENING, MORNING, NIGHT, DEEP_NIGHT and SUN_*), blended across each phase. The game hands it to engine.time.configure.
